title: Manager terminals 1: ~/.dashboard/projects.yaml and a reader for it
notes: Part of the parent card 'Manager terminals: ask the dashboard about any project and dispatch work into it'. Shape per project: name, aka (list of other names, e.g. the screensaver project is known as mandala), path, site, about (one line), deploy (list of name, role such as test or production, address; e.g. new-crm: test new-raxel, production armytech). Reader validates and names the line of a parse error. dashboard project find <word> matches name, aka and about; dashboard project list prints all. Depends on subtask 2 for the command name.

comments.body: PR #156: ~/.dashboard/projects.yaml reader (src/main/projects/projects-file.ts, every problem with its line) and dashboard project list / find <word> (name, aka, about via ranked). Adds yaml 2.9.1. Version 2.34.0.
Shipped in PR #156: reviewed over 3 rounds (11 findings fixed), main merged in, version 2.35.0.
